summary: This is a configuration object that maps human-readable variable and function names from a hangman game to shortened placeholder names. It's likely used as a search-and-replace lookup table to obfuscate or minify the original code by substituting meaningful names with cryptic abbreviated ones.

explanations.2: The 'replace' key indicates this object contains pairs of old values (keys) and new values (values) meant for substitution throughout code.
explanations.3: Each line maps an original name like 'getRandomWord' to its replacement 'ppmx' — this will be used to find-and-replace that function name everywhere in the codebase.
